about: The polish cases of the indexes verb and the kept indexes (fix-j31-kept-indexes, 2026-11-15), in the shape of polish.json. In a file of their own so that other fixes' cases don't collide with them.

cases.title: indexes: what SFSearch keeps on disk, each index's size, coverage and age, and how to drop it; sfs_status's line (fix-j31-kept-indexes)
cases.before: Nothing said what the service's two indexes take on disk, and they were made again at every start.

pass_if.name: the three indexes with size, coverage and age (world: whether asked for); kept; how to drop; the status line

all.matches: (?m)^\| header \| [\d.,]+ (KB|MB|GB) \| [\d,]+ of [\d,]+ plugins \| \d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d
(?m)^\| links \| [\d.,]+ (KB|MB|GB|bytes) \| [\d,]+ of [\d,]+ plugins that can be walked \|
Made again from nothing
indexes drop all
keepStartupIndexes
(?m)^(Kept indexes|Indexes): header [\d.,]+ (KB|MB|GB), links [\d.,]+ (KB|MB|GB|bytes), world (none \(made only when asked: indexes build world\)|[\d.,]+ (KB|MB|GB|bytes)) in .*indexes; .*indexes
(?m)^\| world \| [\d.,]+ (KB|MB|GB|bytes) \| [\d,]+ of [\d,]+ plugins with world data \((not asked for|asked for: [\w,]+)\) \|

cases.title: indexes build: makes what is missing, says when nothing is; --in is for the link index only (fix-j31-kept-indexes)
cases.before: There was no way to make the indexes on demand; __links build was the indexer's own job.

pass_if.name: made or already there; the header index is checked; --in refused for it

cases.title: indexes drop: deletes an index or one plugin's part while the service runs; says how it comes back (fix-j31-kept-indexes)
cases.before: The scratch folder held the indexes and was emptied only at a service start; nothing deleted one index.

pass_if.name: dropped, made again, and the missing index name refused

cases.title: indexes build world: the world link index of the plugins named, made only when asked; refs answers from it; drop forgets it (fix-j32-world-links)
cases.before: refs found links from world data (cells, placed objects, navmeshes) only by searching the world data's bytes: several seconds a question for a Starfield.esm record, left out by default.
